The Planes of Existence

The Prime Plane is the balanced home world of ordinary adventurers. Other planes are arranged around it: the Ethereal Plane overlays the Prime, the four Elemental Planes connect to it through wormholes, and the Outer Planes lie beyond them. Interplanar travel normally passes through the Ethereal Plane, because direct travel between the Prime and the elemental spheres is not available to ordinary characters.

In the Ethereal Plane ether appears as gray fog. Light works normally but illuminates only the ether; infravision is nearly useless because everything shares the same temperature. Visitors can breathe, cannot fall, and cannot walk. Movement requires magic and changes with the material nearby on the Prime Plane: vacuum doubles speed, air is normal, fire or water reduces it to three quarters, soil or wood to half, rock to one quarter, and metal or lead stops movement entirely.

Elemental planes are hostile environments. Air dominates Water, Water dominates Fire, Fire dominates Earth, and Earth dominates Air; Air and Fire oppose each other, as do Earth and Water. Survival requires spells such as create air or survival, a ring of elemental adaptation, or a talisman of elemental travel. Energy-based effects work normally; matter-based effects may be altered or negated.

The Outer Planes are the realms of alignment, deities and immortal powers. They are reached by advanced magic or immortal travel. Beyond the multiverse lies whatever the DM places there; use the same plane rules as a frontier rather than assuming fixed physics.
